name: Range
shortDescription: Advisory membership with an AI assistant. Premium is $3,950 per year.
longDescription: Range is a flat-fee advisory membership that includes its AI assistant, Rai. The Form ADV on range.com, read October 16, 2026, lists Premium at $3,950 per year, Platinum at $5,950, and Titanium at $12,500, with no separate assets-under-management advisory fee. This is not financial advice.
